archetypes.name: dyn-proposal-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The change introduces status transitions and same-ID reconciliation across runs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect proposal parsing, stable-identity reconciliation, filed-issue precedence, and adopted-to-orphaned transitions. Check malformed or ambiguous GitHub responses fail closed without writing refreshed artifacts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
